questions.title: if-else Statement Behavior
questions.description: Which of the following correctly describes the if-else statement in C?
questions.Option1: if executes its block when the condition is non-zero; otherwise the else block executes
questions.Option2: if requires a semicolon immediately after the condition
questions.Option3: else is mandatory in every if statement
questions.Option4: if statements cannot be nested inside another if

questions.title: Default Case Purpose
questions.description: What is the purpose of the default case in a switch statement?
questions.Option1: It executes when no case label matches the switch expression
questions.Option2: It must always be the first case in the switch
questions.Option3: It is mandatory in every switch statement
questions.Option4: It executes before any other case, regardless of value

questions.title: Break Role in Switch
questions.description: Why is break commonly used inside a switch-case statement?
questions.Option1: To exit the switch block and prevent fall-through to subsequent cases
questions.Option2: To skip the current case only without affecting others
questions.Option3: To restart the switch from the first case
questions.Option4: To terminate the entire program immediately

questions.title: else-if Ladder Evaluation
questions.description: How does an else-if ladder evaluate its conditions?
questions.Option1: Conditions are tested in order; the first true one executes its block and the rest are skipped
questions.Option2: All conditions whose expressions are true will execute their blocks
questions.Option3: Only the last condition in the ladder is ever tested
questions.Option4: Conditions are evaluated in parallel and the earliest finishing wins

questions.title: Nested if Definition
questions.description: What is a nested if statement?
questions.Option1: An if statement placed inside another if or else block
questions.Option2: An if statement with multiple conditions joined by && and ||
questions.Option3: An if statement that has no else clause at all
questions.Option4: An if statement used exclusively inside a for loop

questions.title: Continue Statement Effect
questions.description: What does the continue statement do inside a loop in C?
questions.Option1: It skips the remaining statements in the current iteration and moves to the next iteration
questions.Option3: It restarts the loop from its very first iteration

questions.title: Stacked Case Labels
questions.description: What is the effect of stacking multiple case labels before a single statement, e.g. case 1: case 2: printf(...); ?
questions.Option1: The same statement executes for any of the listed case values
questions.Option2: Only the last case label triggers the statement
questions.Option4: Only the first case label triggers the statement
